caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic tureen with a lid, rendered in a realistic style on a plain, off-white background. The tureen is predominantly white or light gray and features two ornate handles on either side, both with subtle red and purple accents. The body and lid of the tureen are decorated with a central motif consisting of a purple bird, surrounded by multicolored flowers and green foliage, with the flowers in blue, red, and purple hues. The edge of the lid and base of the tureen are adorned with repeating red diagonal stripes and patterns. The lid is topped with a pointed knob that has a reddish tip, and both the lid and the rim of the tureen have scalloped detailing, with additional small purple dot decorations along the rim.
title: Sugar Bowl
